stageHeight.name: Stage Height (%)
stageHeight.hint: Height of the visual novel stage area as a percentage of the viewport height.

stageWidth.name: Stage Width (%)
stageWidth.hint: Width of the visual novel stage area as a percentage of the viewport width.

ppEnabled.name: Character Grade
ppEnabled.hint: Colour-grade stage character art with the grade set for each scene in the Stage Director, so the cast reads as standing in the room rather than pasted over it.

ppIntensity.name: Character Grade Strength (%)
ppIntensity.hint: Blends the whole character grade back toward the original art. 100% applies every layer exactly as set; lower it to back the whole look off at once.

ppQuality.name: Character Grade Quality
ppQuality.hint: Your own setting only — it does not change what anyone else sees. Turn this off if the stage costs you performance.

commsTheme.name: Comms Theme
commsTheme.hint: Visual style for the call-in overlay.

commsEdge.name: Comms Edge
commsEdge.hint: Which screen edge the call-in cards stack against.

commsVAlign.name: Comms Vertical Anchor
commsVAlign.hint: Where the call-in stack anchors vertically. The vertical offset below is measured relative to this anchor.

commsFrameWidth.name: Comms Card Width (px)
commsFrameWidth.hint: Width of each call-in portrait card in pixels.

commsEdgeOffset.name: Comms Edge Spacing (px)
commsEdgeOffset.hint: Gap between the call-in stack and its screen edge, in pixels.

commsTopOffset.name: Comms Vertical Offset (%)
commsTopOffset.hint: Vertical offset relative to the anchor, as a percentage of viewport height. When centered it nudges up (negative) or down (positive); when anchored from the top or bottom it sets the gap from that edge.

guide.title: Stage Setup Guide
guide.intro: Configure your actors to display consistently across all player screens.
guide.step1: Click 'Add Actor' to create characters. Give them a name and select their image. Use character art with transparent backgrounds for best results.
guide.step2: Adjust Scale to resize the actor (1.0 = 100%). Use Offset X/Y to fine-tune positioning within the stage. These values sync to all players.
guide.step3: Switch to the Stage tab to control what players see. Add slots (positions) for characters. Assign actors to slots or leave them empty for spacing.
guide.step4: Click Highlight on a character to dim others and indicate the speaker. Use animations for expressive moments — bounce for excitement, shake for anger, nod for agreement.
guide.tip: Tip: Use 'Show Stage' to make the stage visible to all players. 'Clear Stage' removes all characters but keeps actors configured.

grade.noScene: Open a scene to grade its characters.
grade.resampleHint: Read the background again for the light's colour, the room's colour and the light's direction. Keeps every amount you have set.
grade.resetHint: Replace this scene's grade with the world default.
grade.saveDefaultHint: Make this grade the one every ungraded scene starts from.
grade.savedDefault: Saved as the world's default grade.
grade.saveFailed: The scene grade could not be saved — see the console.

basic.title: Basic correction
basic.hint: The art's own tone and colour, before any light touches it. Every dial moves one thing only.

light.title: Light
light.hint: The scene's one light, shared by every character so they are all lit from the same side. The arrows are shortcuts; the angle is exact.

gradient.title: Light gradient
gradient.hint: The light's colour across each figure, strongest on the side facing it.

wash.title: Room wash
wash.hint: The room's colour over the whole figure, without changing how bright it is — and how far characters darken with the scene's darkness.

rim.title: Rim light
rim.hint: Light catching the edge that faces the lamp.

backShadow.title: Backlight shadow
backShadow.hint: Darkens the side of each figure turned away from the light.

glow.title: Glow
glow.hint: The art's own highlights blooming, and spilling a little past the outline.

looks.title: Looks
looks.importHint: A 3D LUT exported from Resolve, Photoshop, Lightroom or any grading tool. It is copied into this world's folder.
looks.importFailed: That file could not be imported: {reason}
looks.removeCustom: Remove this imported look from the list

skin.title: Skin protection
skin.hint: How hard skin holds back the colour of the gradient, wash and looks. It never holds back brightness: a face in a dark room still darkens.
